title: asap-ireports
summary: Repository front page framing asap-ireports as an architecture handoff deliverable, restating the decision-support boundary, Milestone 1 status, decided stack, and a document index.
scope: project deliverable framing (proven architecture + handoff package, not a product)
findings as proposals until human disposition
Milestone 1 status (1a contracts, 1b landscape scan, 1c bake-off)
orchestration bake-off (LangGraph, Strands Agents SDK, hand-rolled Python)
quickstart commands (uv sync, pytest, generate_schemas.py, docker compose)
decided stack (Python 3.12+, FastAPI, Pydantic v2, PostgreSQL, OpenSearch, LiteLLM to Bedrock, Docling/OCRmyPDF/Chonkie, OpenTelemetry + Jaeger)

notes: Manifest declared DOC at precedence 10; accepted as authoritative and consistent with heuristics (prose-heavy front page, no Decision/Consequences sections, no user stories, no endpoint or schema tables). SUMMARY SOURCE ONLY - useful for project scope and one-line framing, not an authority on current state. Where the Status section disagrees with docs/ROADMAP.md, the roadmap wins; the README is expected to lag. Do not extract requirements, technical constraints, or decisions from this file when a higher-precedence source covers the same ground: the decision-support boundary and stack rules belong to CLAUDE.md and docs/DECISIONS.md, milestone state belongs to docs/ROADMAP.md, and the orchestration framework choice belongs to ADR-012 (recorded here as still Open). Restated-but-not-owned constraints visible here for cross-checking only: no aggregate risk score in any contract, findings are proposals until a human records a disposition, nothing reaches ASAP without that disposition, synthetic data only, and blueprint.md is the project's input rather than its output with this repo's decisions winning on divergence. Status as written on this page: 1a contracts done (thirteen Pydantic v2 contracts, component-architecture write-up outstanding), 1b landscape scan done (candidate set cut from four to three, PydanticAI / Pydantic Graph dropped for lack of a state-persistence API in Pydantic Graph 2.x), 1c bake-off in progress with the hand-rolled baseline passing all four legs and LangGraph and Strands still to run. Filename hash suffix is a deterministic path-derived token; SHA-256 was not computable without shell access.
